correctness.rationale: Independent reconstruction of the chord-normal reduction, supporting-height parity, positive spanning criterion, signed polygon-area identity, and redundancy criterion. The full 3674 nonredundant four-normal and 330 three-normal comparisons are certified by independently rerunnable standard-library rational outward interval arithmetic with π and trig Taylor remainder bounds. The eleven winners coincide with the predicted orbit, with a strict nonwinner excess above 0.008. No general-n inference is made.

originality.rationale: The new 11-gon exact optimum and eleven normal-index equality classification are not supplied by the materially inspected Vígh paper or the published 7/9-gon and all-n parallelogram findings. The finite classification does not follow from a 7- or 9-gon specific computation; the parallelogram theorem restricts the enclosure class and is quantitatively weaker here. value.rationale: This is an exact, natural nontrivial fixed-order invariant in a newly studied chord-quadrilateral enclosure problem. The 11-gon is the next odd order after competing 7-gon edge-only and 9-gon diagonal-supported behaviors, showing a return to exclusively edge-supported minimizers and eleven-fold rigidity; the exact discrete gap is a useful benchmark for understanding active-support transitions. The finite scope does not claim general significance beyond this motivated structural comparison.
